diagnosis.narrative: The series is dominated by a strong upward trend (a net rise of ~113% of its level). A moderate seasonal pattern is present. A few outliers stand out (171 points, ~8% of the sample). Across validation windows the model ranking is moderate (Kendall tau 0.47), which favours a weighted combination.
